scope: The percentage concerns the selected father as John Glasgow, farmer, named in the 1846 marriage of John Glasgow-867. It does not identify him with the 1796 Desertoghill flax grower, establish his Larne ancestry, identify a mother or resolve Alexander’s separate death identity. Percentages are subjective evidence assessments, not calibrated statistical probabilities.
limitations: The probate citation is an incomplete service notice, not an adjudicated pedigree: Alexander’s living son Robert was omitted. John’s Ballydonnelly description and the cited Lizzie remain unexplained. The underlying petition and heir schedule have not been inspected. These are real limits, but no held competing household matches the James Garvin/Ann group and no evidence identifies different Glasgow fathers through a maternal half-sibling relationship. The flax-grower and older Larne identities remain separate hypotheses.
source_inspection: Re-evaluation of held original-record readings and the previously collated probate transcription; no newly inspected original in this batch. Repeated newspaper printings are one citation, not independent witnesses.
